hail.text: Ah — the Scout's helper. Come closer.

locked.text: [Spire Herbalist] I'm waiting on word from the Fungus Scout near the Spire. Help them first — I have no ask for you yet.

greet.text: The Scout said you cleared the fungi. Will you take a small herb pouch as thanks?

greet_again.text: Still interested in that herb pouch?

accept.text: Here you are — and a few Lumens for the road. You've earned a rest.

decline.text: Keep the thought, then. The offer stands.

done.text: Those herbs should keep. Visit the Scout if more fungi appear.
